worktrees.agent.badPlacement.text: The panes can't be placed like that in this layout.
worktrees.agent.badPlacement.note: An error: saving where the user put the agents' panes in a layout (dragging a pane to another cell) was given a layout or places Combwork doesn't know.

worktrees.agent.badWorkflowRole.text: A role in the workflow is builder, reviewer, either, generalist or independent.
worktrees.agent.badWorkflowRole.note: An error: an agent's role in the workflow was given as something else. builder, reviewer, either, generalist and independent are values: keep them in English.

worktrees.agent.chooseMove.text: Choose where to move the agent.
worktrees.agent.chooseMove.note: An error: an agent was to be moved in the project's order, with no place given.

worktrees.agent.effortRefused.text: {chosen, select, yes {{model}} other {The CLI's default model}} doesn't take {effort} effort. Choose one of the levels it takes.
worktrees.agent.effortRefused.note: An error saving an agent's (or a connection's) settings (HI-2106): the model that would run (its name, {model}, when one is chosen; else the CLI's own default) has no such reasoning effort level ({effort}: "max").

worktrees.agent.enterName.note: An error: an agent's name was emptied.

worktrees.agent.gone.note: An error: the agent being changed was removed meanwhile.

worktrees.agent.nameTaken.text: There is already an agent called "{name}".
worktrees.agent.nameTaken.note: An error: the project already has an agent with the name {name}.

worktrees.agent.noTree.text: This agent works in the project folder, not a worktree.
worktrees.agent.noTree.note: An error: something only a worktree agent has (its branch's state, a merge) was asked of an agent working in the project folder.

worktrees.agent.notPinned.text: Agents aren’t pinned to worktrees in 1.0: slots are lent per card or lane.
worktrees.agent.notPinned.note: An error: an agent was to be added in a worktree of its own (a new or an existing one), which 1.0 doesn't do: Combwork lends a working folder (a slot) to each card or lane instead (glossary 2.5: slot, lane).

worktrees.agent.providerChangedMeanwhile.text: {agent}'s provider was changed meanwhile: nothing was changed. Try again.
worktrees.agent.providerChangedMeanwhile.note: An error saving an agent's settings (HI-1771): its provider (coding agent CLI) was changed by something else while this change was being saved, so nothing was saved. {agent} is its name.

worktrees.agent.removing.text: That worktree is already being removed or merged.
worktrees.agent.removing.note: An error: the worktree is being removed or merged by another action right now.

worktrees.agent.roleTooLong.text: A role is at most {max} characters.
worktrees.agent.roleTooLong.note: An error: an agent's role (what it does, in a few words) is longer than it may be ({max}, a number).

worktrees.agent.stopForProvider.text: Stop the agent before changing its provider.
worktrees.agent.stopForProvider.note: An error: an agent's provider (its coding-agent CLI) can't change while it runs.

worktrees.agent.stopToMerge.text: Stop {agent} before merging and removing its worktree.
worktrees.agent.stopToMerge.note: An error: a merge that also removes the worktree needs the agent {agent} (its name) stopped first.

worktrees.agent.stopToRemove.text: Stop the agent before removing it.
worktrees.agent.stopToRemove.note: An error: a running agent can't be removed.

worktrees.agent.unknownProvider.note: An error: {provider} is not a coding-agent CLI this Combwork knows (Claude Code, Codex…).

worktrees.badBranchName.text: "{branch}" is not a valid branch name.
worktrees.badBranchName.note: An error: git doesn't take {branch} as a branch name.

worktrees.branchInWay.text: Git can't make the branch {branch}: a branch {parent} is in the way. Choose another branch.
worktrees.branchInWay.note: An error: a new branch {branch} can't be made, because a branch {parent} exists and git can't have a branch inside another's name.

worktrees.cantCheck.note: An error: git couldn't count the branch {branch}'s unmerged commits or its worktree's uncommitted files; {why} says why.

worktrees.deleteBranch.note: An error: the branch {branch} could not be deleted, and git said nothing about why.

worktrees.gitFailed.note: Why git couldn't do something, when git said nothing itself. {command} is the git command ("git rev-parse"): keep it as it is.

worktrees.gitProblem.note: An error: git cannot run. {problem} says why (git is missing, or too old), without its full stop.

worktrees.listBranches.note: An error: git couldn't list the repository's branches; {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.missing.noAgent.note: An error: the agent whose missing worktree was to be recreated or unlinked was removed meanwhile.

worktrees.missing.noBranch.text: {agent}'s branch {branch} is gone, and the project folder isn't on a branch to start a new one from.
worktrees.missing.noBranch.note: An error: the missing worktree of the agent {agent} (its name) can't be recreated: its branch {branch} is gone too, and there's no branch to make a new one from.

worktrees.missing.noTree.note: An error: the agent {agent} (its name) works in the project folder, so it has no worktree to recreate or unlink.

worktrees.missing.slotFailed.text: Slot {slot} of agent {agent} couldn't be made again: {why}
worktrees.missing.slotFailed.note: An error: a slot lent to the agent {agent} (its name), whose folder was gone, couldn't be made again ({slot}: the slot's name; {why}: why, often git's message in English). A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

worktrees.missing.stillListed.text: git still lists {folder} as a worktree (it may be locked): unlock it, or run git worktree prune, then try again.
worktrees.missing.stillListed.note: An error: git still has the missing worktree {folder} on its list, so it can't be recreated there. git worktree prune is a git command: keep it.

worktrees.missing.stopFirst.note: An error: the agent {agent} (its name) is running; its missing worktree can't be recreated until it stops.

worktrees.missing.thereRecreate.text: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): there's nothing to recreate.
worktrees.missing.thereRecreate.note: An error: the worktree folder {folder} of the agent {agent} (its name) exists, so it isn't missing.

worktrees.missing.thereUnlink.text: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): remove the agent to remove its worktree.
worktrees.missing.thereUnlink.note: An error: the worktree folder {folder} of the agent {agent} (its name) exists, so its link can't be dropped as a missing one.

worktrees.missing.wouldPrune.text: Recreating runs git worktree prune, which would also drop git's link to {folders} (missing too). Locate, recreate or remove {n, plural, one {that worktree} other {those worktrees}} first.
worktrees.missing.wouldPrune.note: An error: recreating a missing worktree runs git worktree prune (a git command: keep it), which would also forget the other missing worktrees {folders} (a list of folders); {n} is how many.

worktrees.names.closed.text: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
worktrees.names.closed.note: An error: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while a project's name was being recorded; nothing changed.

worktrees.names.projectGone.text: That project is no longer in the workspace.
worktrees.names.projectGone.note: An error: the project whose name was being recorded was removed from the workspace meanwhile.

worktrees.readBranch.text: git couldn't read the branch checked out in {folder} ({why})
worktrees.readBranch.note: An error: git couldn't say which branch the folder {folder} has checked out; {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.readOriginHead.note: An error: git couldn't read which branch is the remote's main branch (origin/HEAD, git's name: keep it); {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.statusFailed.text: git status failed in its folder
worktrees.statusFailed.note: Why git couldn't check a worktree (after "Git couldn't check <branch>:"): git status failed in the worktree's folder. Lower case.

worktrees.unknownError.note: Why git couldn't do something, when nothing at all was said. Lower case: it follows a colon.
